experiment: RQ4 full-action latency: XGrammar canonical-lattice baseline vs Policy2Sample

decode.selection: greedy argmax among allowed token IDs
decode.paired_order: alternated by case index and repetition

timing_boundary: Per-request setup and P2S specialization through prompt prefill, constrained decode, and JSON parse. Excludes model loading, vocabulary extraction, grammar compilation, and global action-lattice tokenization.

methods.schema_only: XGrammar structural mask intersected with once-compiled canonical trie for the full finite action lattice; no safety filtering.
methods.policy2sample: Same XGrammar grammar with per-request safe-domain prefix mask; projection, safe candidate serialization, and prefix trie construction are included in timed latency.

limitations: Finite discrete action lattice; not continuous numeric token enforcement.
No simulator or physical hardware replay in this latency experiment.
IoT output token count differs between methods because selected action values differ; E2E delta is not pure mask overhead.
The archived XGrammar runtime version could not be recovered from the result metadata and is recorded as unknown.
